title: Models: Golem body/head/fists and Plantera hooks/tentacles rebuilt realistically
player_outcome: Golem is a carved Lihzahrd idol whose head and fists are separate stone pieces with glowing eyes and a sun disc. Plantera's hooks are thorny vine claws and her tentacles snap on fleshy stalks.
design: golem_body: bevelled carved stone blocks, glyph relief via displacement noise, a sun disc with glow, stubby legs, rigid bones for a jump squash clip. No head or fists.
golem_head: a carved head with glowing eye slots.
golem_head_free: the head with rocket/ember glow underneath.
golem_fist: a carved fist with knuckles and glyph bands.
plantera_hook: a thorn-studded claw of vine (detail.organic plus spikes).
plantera_tentacle: a toothy bud with a jaw clip via bosses_pre2.clips.
Tri targets: body 6–10k, parts 2–4k. Materials: prop:stone, prop:plain:glow, prop:bark or plant layers.
Register the module in build_all.py's creature lookup, add assets.json creature entries, and keep golem_idol until P4-31 switches the golem's model.
files_add: tools/blender/bgen/bosses_temple.py — Golem parts, Plantera hook and tentacle
tests: build_all.py --check passes once P4-30/31 reference the models; AssetCoverage passes.
verification: tools/blender/preview.py contact sheets reviewed against Terraria's Golem and Plantera silhouettes
